remodel.heading: From Quick Fixes to Full Remodels.
remodel.line: New tubs, showers, vanities and kitchens, roughed in and trimmed out by the same crew that builds them new.

items.title: You Talk to the Plumber
items.text: Ryan answers the phone and bids every job. No call center between you and the person doing the work.

items.title: Price Before We Start
items.text: You get the price before work begins. If we open something up and find more, we stop and talk first.

items.title: A Master Plumber on Every Job
items.text: Ryan holds a Missouri Master Plumber license. The crew is licensed, insured and background-checked.

items.title: The Same Crew Builders Trust
items.text: Most of our work is new construction for builders on schedules that don't tolerate no-shows. You get that same crew.

hero.heading: Let's Build Together.
hero.lead: Reliable plumbing crews for new construction and renovations, from the first takeoff to the final walk.

services.heading: Our Builder Services
services.line: One crew from the first takeoff to the final walk.

items.title: Bid & Plan Review
items.text: Fixture counts and layouts off your drawings, with questions asked before the number goes out.

items.title: Underground & Rough-In
items.text: Drain, waste and vent under the slab, then supply and DWV through the framing.

items.title: Inspections & Top-Out
items.text: We meet the inspector, pressure test, and hand the framing back ready for drywall.

items.title: Trim & Punch
items.text: Fixtures, water heater and appliance hookups, then we work the punch list until it's clear.
